tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search nosebleed.si for plain-English, step-by-step guides on using SI (AI) for an everyday or small-business task, for example "explain a letter", "plan a trip", "write a quote", "VAT", "take a screenshot". Returns the best matches with links.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Get the full text of one nosebleed.si guide: steps, copyable example prompts, follow-up questions and warnings. Pass the page address from search_guides or list_guides.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: List every nosebleed.si guide, grouped by section, with its address and a one-line summary. Optionally only one section, e.g. "business", "ideas" or "basics".
